Pakistan Cricket Captain Babar Azam Suffers Finger Injury

Pakistan cricket captain Babar Azam sustained a finger injury during practice, casting doubt on his participation in the first Test match against England. The extent of the injury and its impact on his availability for the upcoming game are currently unclear. Video footage of the incident has been circulated.
